crossRefs.note: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike…
Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.”…
Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king…
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’ ”
translations.bsb: Then Absalom sent spies throughout the tribes of Israel with this message: “When you hear the sound of the horn, you are to say, ‘Absalom reigns in Hebron!’”
translations.kjv: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
translations.asv: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom is king in Hebron.
